name: lookback
description: Searches your past Claude Code sessions by words and by meaning. A local SQLite index and local Ollama embeddings, no cloud, no daemon.

limit.title: Sessions per search
limit.description: How many past sessions a search returns.

autoRecall.title: Recall when you ask about past work
autoRecall.description: When a prompt asks about earlier work ("didn't we fix this", "what was that error"), search and hand Claude the best matches beside the prompt.

autoIndex.title: Index at session start
autoIndex.description: Read new transcript lines in the background when a session starts.

errorHints.title: Hint after a failed command
errorHints.description: When a shell command fails, look up what past sessions ran after the same error and hand it to Claude with the result.

sessionDigest.title: List recent sessions at session start
sessionDigest.description: Put the 5 latest sessions of the folder, one line each with a title, in the system prompt, so Claude knows what was done here before.

fileNotes.title: Note a file's history on first touch
fileNotes.description: The first time a session reads or changes a file that earlier sessions changed, hand Claude one short note: how many sessions changed it, and the latest ones with what was asked.

fileTools.title: MCP tools that name files
fileTools.description: MCP tools or whole servers whose calls read or change files, split by commas, such as mcp__semantic-cache-mcp or mcp__myserver__edit. Their file paths are recorded beside those of the built-in Read, Edit and Write. A change reads the transcripts again for files only.

embeddingModel.title: Embedding model
embeddingModel.description: The model Ollama serves for embeddings. A different model rebuilds the vectors.

embeddingUrl.title: Embedding endpoint
embeddingUrl.description: The OpenAI-compatible base URL of the embedding server. Ollama serves one at /v1.

captionServer.title: Image caption server command
captionServer.description: A llama-server command with a vision model and its --mmproj, such as: llama-server -m model.gguf --mmproj mmproj.gguf. lookback starts it when there are pasted images to caption and stops it when done; it adds --host and --port. Empty leaves captions to the model below.

captionModel.title: Image caption model
captionModel.description: A vision model a running server serves at the caption endpoint, such as lfm2.5-vl in Ollama. Empty, with no server command, leaves pasted images uncaptioned.

captionUrl.title: Image caption endpoint
captionUrl.description: The OpenAI-compatible base URL of a running server for the caption model. Your screenshots are sent there.
